stories.title: AI creates 16 new viruses that never existed in nature after learning DNA’s pattern from 9 trillion nucleotides — experts warn such applications are way ahead of necessary guardrails

sources.title: AI creates 16 new viruses that never existed in nature after learning DNA’s pattern from 9 trillion nucleotides — experts warn such applications are way ahead of necessary guardrails
sources.title_en: AI creates 16 new viruses that never existed in nature after learning DNA’s pattern from 9 trillion nucleotides — experts warn such applications are way ahead of necessary guardrails
sources.title_original: AI creates 16 new viruses that never existed in nature after learning DNA’s pattern from 9 trillion nucleotides — experts warn such applications are way ahead of necessary guardrails
sources.summary: Researchers used Evo AI models trained on trillions of DNA building blocks to design entirely new viral genomes, 16 of which became viable bacteriophages capable of infecting and reproducing inside E. coli.
sources.summary_zh: 研究人员使用经过数万亿个 DNA 构建模块训练的 Evo AI 模型来设计全新的病毒基因组，其中 16 个成为能够在大肠杆菌内感染和繁殖的可行噬菌体。

stories.title: Modder turns Steam Controller trackpad haptics into stereo speakers with custom HID tool — Wired connection transmits 16-bit audio that sounds surprisingly full

sources.title: Modder turns Steam Controller trackpad haptics into stereo speakers with custom HID tool — Wired connection transmits 16-bit audio that sounds surprisingly full

sources.title_original: Modder turns Steam Controller trackpad haptics into stereo speakers with custom HID tool — Wired connection transmits 16-bit audio that sounds surprisingly full
sources.summary: A modder has figured out how to send an audio stream to the Steam Controller's haptic motors in order to make them play pretty much anything. While the wireless connection over the puck is limited, audio quality over a USB cable is genuinely impressive for a device with no speakers.
sources.summary_zh: 一名改装者已经弄清楚如何将音频流发送到 Steam 控制器的触觉电机，以便让它们播放几乎任何东西。虽然冰球上的无线连接有限，但对于没有扬声器的设备来说，通过 USB 电缆传输的音频质量确实令人印象深刻。
